name: Bug Survivors
summary: A PostHog hoggie survives 3:30 of swarming bugs named after the prospect's pain points, picks PostHog products as auto-firing weapons on level-up and beats a boss; then cashes out or climbs the wave ladder (every boss a release: 2.0, 3.0...) with PostHog tools, releases, powerups, hoggies to unlock and crests to earn.
